findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liminal-http-headers-91moXQ, liminal-url-to-text-yj6VKg · Private data: cc0pedia, cc0pedia-search, cc0pedia-market, schema-drift-guard-ec6XlA, schema-drift-guard-nMF_Hg, cc0-print, liminal-stack-intel-7g6WFg, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, liminal-dns-lookup-xvSPfA · Public sink: cc0-print, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, van-gogh-gen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: liminal-http-headers-91moXQ, liminal-url-to-text-yj6VKg · Private data: cc0pedia, cc0pedia-search, cc0pedia-market, schema-drift-guard-ec6XlA, schema-drift-guard-nMF_Hg, cc0-print, liminal-stack-intel-7g6WFg, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, liminal-dns-lookup-xvSPfA · Public sink: cc0-print, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, van-gogh-gen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
